# Fittrock Ergonomics
> Fittrock Ergonomics LLP is India's leading direct-to-consumer manufacturer of precision electric dual-motor height-adjustable standing desks, ergonomic seating, and workplace wellness solutions engineered in Pune, Maharashtra.

## Company Information
- **Legal Name**: FITTROCK ERGONOMICS LLP
- **Headquarters & Experience Studio**: Office no 610, 6th floor, Park Plaza, Porwal Rd, Lohegaon, Pune, Maharashtra 411047, India
- **Official Website**: https://fittrock.com
- **Customer Support**: contact@fittrock.com | +91 80878 27905 | WhatsApp: +91 86055 91550
- **Business Model**: Direct-from-factory manufacturer (No middlemen markups)

## Flagship Products & Mechanical Specifications

### 1. KUBER Pro Series (Dual Motor Electric Standing Desk)
- **Drive Mechanism**: Synchronized dual German-spec motors (one integrated into each column)
- **Weight Capacity**: 125 kg (tested to hold multiple monitors, heavy CPU towers, and studio audio gear)
- **Transit Speed**: 35 mm/s smooth elevation
- **Noise Level**: Whisper-quiet (<42 dB) — quieter than typical library ambient noise
- **Height Range**: 710 mm (seated posture) to 1190 mm (standing posture)
- **Anti-Collision**: 6-axis gyro collision detection system
- **Hand Controller**: Digital LED handset with 4 programmable memory presets and USB charging port
- **Tabletop Options**: High-density 25mm solid engineered wood with CNC pre-drilled threaded insert holes (Available in Dark Maple Woodgrain, Ice Beach Oak, Matte Black, Frosty White, and Gothic Grey)

### 2. RATI S1 Series (Single Motor Electric Standing Desk)
- **Drive Mechanism**: Single high-torque motor connected via hex drive shaft
- **Weight Capacity**: 80 kg
- **Transit Speed**: 25 mm/s
- **Height Range**: 710 mm to 1190 mm
- **Ideal For**: Compact home workstations, students, and budget-conscious ergonomic setups

### 3. Standalone Motorized Desk Frames
- Telescoping heavy-duty cold-rolled steel frames expandable horizontally from 1000mm to 1600mm to support custom tabletops up to 2000mm length.

## Core Customer Guarantees & Policies
- **Warranty**: 3-Year Frame Structural Warranty against weld failure or bending; 1-Year Electrical Replacement Warranty covering motors, control box circuit boards, transformers, and memory handset.
- **10-Day Risk-Free Trial**: Full 10-day in-home trial with doorstep reverse pickup and 100% money-back guarantee if unsatisfied.
- **Shipping**: 100% Free Express Shipping across 19,000+ Indian postal codes. Dispatched within 24 hours from Pune factory. Metros receive delivery in 2-4 business days.
- **B2B & GST Invoicing**: 18% Input Tax Credit (ITC) compliant tax invoice with GSTIN automatically provided upon checkout.
- **Assembly**: 15–20 minute DIY assembly with pre-drilled holes, labeled Allen keys, screws, and step-by-step video instructions.
